title: `oneOf` / `anyOf`
description: A parameter that accepts one of several shapes, using JSON Schema 2020-12 combinators.
question: Do both union combinators survive to each capture boundary?
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Collapse would silently narrow what the agent is able to express.

notes.langchain4j: LangChain4j 1.22.0-beta32: `McpToolProvider` maps each `inputSchema` into LangChain4j's own `JsonSchemaElement` model (`JsonObjectSchema`, `JsonStringSchema`, `JsonIntegerSchema`, ...), and the `ToolSpecification` AiServices hands the `ChatModel` is built from that model. `anyOf` maps to `JsonAnyOfSchema` and survives. The model has no `oneOf`, so `deliver_payload.mode` becomes an empty `{"type": "object", "properties": {}}` and its alternatives are lost.
